name: a tangled burst of coloured streaks fills the frame
looks: Hundreds of short coloured streaks (mostly white, a few in the accent colours) radiate outward in every direction from a dense centre, tapering and fading toward their tips, reading as a single chaotic burst rather than a path.
build: particle-flow-comet, scaled up to a full-frame burst: many short strokes drawn from a seeded radial velocity field, each a trail of its last few positions, with no single dominant head, so the eye reads density and direction rather than one object.
sound: A dense rising whoosh, like static resolving into wind.
prompt: Fill the frame with hundreds of short coloured streaks radiating outward from the centre in every direction, mostly neutral with a few in the accent colour, each tapering and fading toward its tip. Use it as a pure-energy beat between calmer scenes, with no single focal object to track.
